selection_basis: review accounting gaps and supported modes, never PnL
population_rule: all authorized inventoried accounts at archive_cutoff_ms, unchanged six-hour policy; targeted historical cases reported separately, not ranked

collection_budget.activation: only if archive fails, via existing quota and lease; announce actual receipt cutoff separately

cadence: existing REST cohort, 32 slots, one job/tick, per-account target 3600s; no service or allocation change in archive phase
cohort_check: inspect actual valuation timestamps and cohort residence; if rotation/cadence fails 6h +/-15min and end age<=1h, report exact missing boundary and deadline without weakening policy
preservation: exploration and controls untouched; old report and reserved accounts untouched
success: justified scope calculation or precise public-data impossibility, uniform whole-population application; no account or strategy promotion
